page.overview:
Who is Woodcutter?

Sun Wukong meets a woodcutter / lumberjack in Western Continent.

On his head he wore a hat Woven from the first skin shed by new bamboo shoots. The clothes on his body Were made of yam from the wild cotton−tree. The belt round his waist Was of silk from an old silkworm. The straw sandals under his feet Had straps torn from rotten sago trees. In his hand he held a steel axe On his back he carried a hempen rope At climbing pines and felling dead trees, Who was a match for this woodcutter?

He was raised by his parents until about eight. Then his dad died. His mom remained a widow. He had no siblings. As an only child, he had to look after his mother. Now she is old that he can't possibly leave her. Their land is so overgrown that he can't grow enough to feed and clothe both of them, so he has to cut a couple of bundles of firewood to sell in the market for a handful of coppers to buy the few pints of rice that he cooks for himself and his mom.
